fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 horn thrusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage.

fusions.name: Crossroads Gore
fusions.desc: Sends a thrust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and knocking it back 2 tiles. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Tossed Both Ways
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a second thrust branches to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
